instruction: I'd like Thunderbird to display emails in plain text format instead of HTML for better security and faster loading. Can you configure it to prefer plain text?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling plain text display preference in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks if mailnews.display.prefer_plaintext preference is set to true. This is a standard Thunderbird preference with similar complexity to the original theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets the mailnews.display.prefer_plaintext preference in Thunderbird's prefs.js file
check_thunderbird_prefs metric properly parses the prefs.js file format and extracts preference values
Expected value 'true' is semantically correct for enabling plain text display mode
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are written to disk before verification
Complete coverage: instruction asks to prefer plain text, evaluator checks the exact preference that controls this behavior
Getter correctly extracts the prefs.js file from the expected Thunderbird profile path
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 if file is None, regex parsing handles non-matching lines gracefully

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
